stem.text: The graph shows pressure changes in different parts of the heart during a mammalian cardiac cycle. W, X, Y and Z indicate when a valve opens or closes.

stem.alt: Graph of pressure against time in seconds from 0 to 0.8, with three curves (dashed, solid and dotted, as shown in the key labelled aorta, ventricle and atrium) and labels W, X, Y and Z at points on the curves.

stem.text: Which row correctly identifies W, X, Y and Z?

A.text: atrioventricular valve opens; atrioventricular valve closes; semilunar valve opens; semilunar valve closes

B.text: atrioventricular valve closes; semilunar valve opens; semilunar valve closes; atrioventricular valve opens

C.text: semilunar valve opens; semilunar valve closes; atrioventricular valve opens; atrioventricular valve closes

D.text: semilunar valve closes; atrioventricular valve opens; atrioventricular valve closes; semilunar valve opens
